item.title: Man sentenced in stolen car police chase in Youngstown
item.description: A 19-year-old city man who pleaded guilty to stealing a car from a Pittsburgh airport and leading state troopers on a chase was sentenced Friday in Mahoning County Common Pleas Court to 60 days in the Mahoning County jail

item.title: Heart Smart Chocolate Workshop shares recipes for healthier sweets
item.description: With Valentine's Day right around the corner, flowers and jewelry are usual gifts, but one thing many people want is chocolate.

item.title: Charges reduced for man, woman charged in warrant arrest
item.description: A man who was arrested by Warren police on several warrants out of Newton Falls pleaded guilty Thursday to reduced charges, and the woman he was accused of harming was charged with falsification.

item.title: New Castle man pleads guilty in Puerto Rico-sourced trafficking operation
item.description: A New Castle man has pleaded guilty in federal court for charges relating to a violation of narcotic and firearm laws, according to U.S. Attorney Troy Rivetti.

item.title: Over 200-year-old church closing
item.description: After more than 200 years in the Mahoning Valley, St. James Episcopal Church in Boardman is closing its doors.

item.title: Austintown Senior Center hosts open house
item.description: One out of every four residents in Mahoning County is at least 55 years old. There's a special place for them -- the Austintown Senior Center. It's proven to be a quality place where they can feel like family.

item.title: Youngstown City Schools to fundraise for new stadium scoreboard
item.description: The City of Youngstown School District is looking to raise money to replace the dated scoreboard at Rayen Stadium with a new video board, which will cost around $200,000.

item.title: History will be made at Sunday's Phantoms game
item.description: The Youngstown Phantoms will be holding their first-ever sensory-friendly hockey game on Sunday, sponsored by the Abilities Unite Foundation of the Mahoning Valley, with reduced music and volume, consistent lighting, and around 600 guests from local boards of developmental disabilities.

item.title: PUCO makes calls for new SOBE receivership
item.description: The heat is finally back on again at the Central YMCA downtown, allowing staff to re-open the lap pool after having to close it earlier this week.

item.title: Eight couples get married at Penguin City in pop-up wedding
item.description: Love was in the air Friday night at Penguin City Brewing Co. for a Valentine's Day pop-up wedding ceremony.
